title: Since 2020
goal: Say after, before, since and apart from with the ablative, and put all the postpositions together at the museum.

intro.text: *soň* (after), *öň* (before), *bäri* (since) and *başga* (apart from) take the ablative: *işden soň*, *nahardan öň*, *2020-nji ýyldan bäri*, *senden başga*. With *bäri*, an action that is still going on is in the present: *Irden bäri garaşýaryn*, I've been waiting since the morning.

vocab.en: since; for (a time up to now)
to get to know, to meet (for the first time)

exercises.question: How do you say **since the morning**?

why.1: *bäri* takes the ablative, not the dative: *irden*.
why.2: *bäri* takes the ablative, not the locative: *irden*.
why.3: *bäri* needs the ablative on the word before it: *irden bäri*.

exercises.en: I have lived in Ashgabat since 2020.

reject.why: *bäri* takes the ablative, not the dative: *ýyldan bäri*.

exercises.explain: *ýyl* + *-dan* + *bäri*, and the present *ýaşaýaryn*, because you still live there.

exercises.prompt: I have been waiting since the morning.

reject.why: The waiting is still going on, so Turkmen uses the present with *bäri*: *garaşýaryn*.

exercises.explain: *irden bäri* + the present: *garaşýaryn*, I've been waiting.

accept: Wash your hands before the meal!
Wash your hand before the meal!
Before the meal, wash your hands!

exercises.question: *Senden başga hiç kim bilmeýär.* What does it mean?

why.1: **Nobody knows you** would be *Hiç kim seni tanamaýar*.
why.2: Here *senden başga* is **apart from you**, and *hiç kim* is the subject.

exercises.explain: *senden başga*, apart from you, with *hiç kim* and a negative verb: nobody else knows.

exercises.prompt: After work, let's go to the teahouse.
exercises.explain: *işden soň*, after work; *çaýhana*, the dative fused with the final *a*; *gideli*, let's go.

exercises.en: What would you like apart from tea?
exercises.explain: *başga* takes the ablative when it means **apart from**: *çaýdan başga*.

exercises.prompt: I have been learning Turkmen since last year.
exercises.text: Geçen ýyldan bäri türkmen dilini öwrenýärin.
accept: Türkmen dilini geçen ýyldan bäri öwrenýärin.

exercises.prompt: Alymlar bu ýerde köp ýyldan bäri işleýärler.
accept: Scientists have been working here for many years.
The scientists have been working here for many years.
[Scholars|The scholars|Archaeologists] have been working here for many years.
[Scientists|The scientists|Scholars] have worked here for many years.

exercises.question: Since when has Döwran worked at the museum?

context.en: Hello! What is there in this museum?

context.tk: Bu ýerde Türkmenistanyň taryhy bar. Ine, bu altyn gadymy şäherden.
context.en: Here there's the history of Turkmenistan. Look, this gold is from an ancient city.

context.tk: Sen haçandan bäri bu ýerde işleýärsiň?
context.en: Since when have you worked here?

why.1: *2019-njy ýyldan bäri* counts from 2019 to now, not for nineteen years.

exercises.explain: *2019-njy ýyldan bäri*: since 2019, and he still works there.
*Aýnadan başga*, apart from Aýna; *hemme geldi*, everyone came.

exercises.gloss: from my work (as in: after my work)

exercises.prompt: Come on, let's get to know each other! (to a group)
exercises.explain: *tanyş-* + *-alyň*: let's get to know each other, to a group, after *Geliň*.
